id./param/region/r011.pack|book_ie.bxon|e24: "I thought these children might know something, being her age, but they say they've never heard of her.
id./param/region/r011.pack|book_ie.bxon|fb4: "I thought we could see the whole village from here, but I don't see anyone who looks like Mel's mom and dad...

id./param/region/r011.pack|book_ie.bxon|133: "{var:1}, let's look for her. If we go to the busy plaza, someone may have seen her.
id./param/region/r011.pack|book_ie.bxon|14d: "Come to think of it, that barker said we'd learn something if we stayed at the inn...
id./param/region/r011.pack|book_ie.bxon|163: "...Whew, this village's layout is hard on my legs.
id./param/region/r011.pack|book_ie.bxon|16a: "Erik and the others seem to have already headed for the ruins. I'll rest a while and follow, so go ahead without me.

id./param/region/r011.pack|book_ie.bxon|18b: "Where on earth could she have gone...? I'm so worried.
id./param/region/r011.pack|book_ie.bxon|19c: "The ruins are past the stairs, down from the hill. Everyone should have gone ahead.
id./param/region/r011.pack|book_ie.bxon|1ab: "...Still, this village has a unique atmosphere. It's famous for its ruins, but the fervor here is almost scary.
id./param/region/r011.pack|book_ie.bxon|1c1: "That girl Mel you mentioned, separated from her father and mother... she must feel so helpless.
id./param/region/r011.pack|book_ie.bxon|1cd: "That night sixteen years ago, I too...
id./param/region/r011.pack|book_ie.bxon|1d3: "...No, it's nothing. Let's find her quickly so she doesn't feel lonely.
id./param/region/r011.pack|book_ie.bxon|1f5: Words are carved on the crumbling stone tablet. It seems to be a message left by whoever discovered this mural...
id./param/region/r011.pack|book_ie.bxon|202: Near the village, I chanced upon a mysterious mural of the ancient Pwachat Kingdom, fallen centuries ago...
id./param/region/r011.pack|book_ie.bxon|211: People would gather and the village would prosper. ...But that was a grave mistake. The mural was cursed with evil.
id./param/region/r011.pack|book_ie.bxon|21f: To feed on lives, the mural grants desires with strange power, misleads people, and absorbs those seeking its blessings.
id./param/region/r011.pack|book_ie.bxon|231: And before the unselfish, it appears as a girl, preys on their goodwill, deceives them, and drags them into the mural...
id./param/region/r011.pack|book_ie.bxon|241: ...The writing on the tablet breaks off here.
id./param/region/r011.pack|book_ie.bxon|259: A crack in this space might lead back to the outside world. Jump into the rift?

id./param/region/r011.pack|book_ie.bxon|29e: For now, it seems best to head to Phnom Nonh for Bahatra.
id./param/region/r011.pack|book_ie.bxon|2aa: "Wait, {var:1}. Sylvando shouldn't have left the village. Don't you need to find him?
id./param/region/r011.pack|book_ie.bxon|2bf: It's a book called "The Great Gambaldi and His Designs."
id./param/region/r011.pack|book_ie.bxon|2c5: Of the many works left by the great designer Gambaldi, the masterpiece is said to be a ship called the Sylvando.
id./param/region/r011.pack|book_ie.bxon|2d4: The Sylvando is the world's finest ship in speed and beauty; experts say its secret is the distinctive bow.
id./param/region/r011.pack|book_ie.bxon|2e5: Ships cut through waves, but the Sylvando's needle bow glides as if playing with them, never resisting or wounding.
id./param/region/r011.pack|book_ie.bxon|2f6: Its appearance is like a cheerful traveling entertainer, reminiscent of the friend who commissioned its design.
id./param/region/r011.pack|book_ie.bxon|313: It's a book called "Secrets of the Ancient Pwachat Kingdom."
id./param/region/r011.pack|book_ie.bxon|319: The true cause of the ancient Pwachat Kingdom's fall remains unsolved, but recent research has revealed some things.
id./param/region/r011.pack|book_ie.bxon|329: Even a dying nation has people living in it. If caused by plague or disaster, the survivors would hold rites for the dead.
id./param/region/r011.pack|book_ie.bxon|339: But the Pwachat Ruins show no human graves or traces of burial.
id./param/region/r011.pack|book_ie.bxon|343: This implies that at the kingdom's end, not even mourners remained. A terrifying hypothesis arises.
id./param/region/r011.pack|book_ie.bxon|34f: The same features appear in the ruins of two fallen great kingdoms: Bandelfon and Dundrasil.
id./param/region/r011.pack|book_ie.bxon|35c: One possibility is that they were attacked by monsters bent on wiping out all life.
id./param/region/r011.pack|book_ie.bxon|376: It's a picture book called "When I Become a Star." An illustration shows a woman lying in bed gently stroking a boy's head.
id./param/region/r011.pack|book_ie.bxon|383: Oh, my sweet Schwell. Please don't cry so. Mama isn't going to disappear.
id./param/region/r011.pack|book_ie.bxon|38b: I'll ask the Great Tree to make me the highest star in the sky.
id./param/region/r011.pack|book_ie.bxon|393: Then, whether you are sad or trembling with joy, I'll be watching you from the sky forever.
id./param/region/r011.pack|book_ie.bxon|39b: So Schwell, don't cry. With your sweet eyes, find Mama's star shining in the sky.
id./param/region/r011.pack|book_ie.bxon|3b2: It's a free tourist pamphlet called "A Walker's Guide to Phnom Nonh."
id./param/region/r011.pack|book_ie.bxon|3bb: Recently a beauty was found in a mural deep in the ruins, making the Pwachat Ruins popular as a lucky power spot.
id./param/region/r011.pack|book_ie.bxon|3ca: These ruins are thought to be remains of the ancient Pwachat Kingdom, destroyed hundreds of years ago.
id./param/region/r011.pack|book_ie.bxon|3d6: Why did the Pwachat Kingdom, proud of its vast lands and wealth, walk the road to ruin?
id./param/region/r011.pack|book_ie.bxon|3e1: Theories include the king's madness, disaster, or a sudden monster attack, but the mystery remains unsolved.
id./param/region/r011.pack|book_ie.bxon|3f4: When visiting the Pwachat Ruins, why not only pray for luck but also reflect on the lost kingdom's footsteps?
id./param/region/r011.pack|book_ie.bxon|415: It seems to be a very old book... The faded cover reads, in old letters, "Nelsen's Secret Book: Water."
id./param/region/r011.pack|book_ie.bxon|432: It seems to be a very old book... The faded cover reads, in old letters, "Nelsen's Secret Book: Water."

id./param/region/r011.pack|book_ie.bxon|449: Move like flowing water, bound by nothing. Then even the swiftest enemy attack can be easily dodged.
id./param/region/r011.pack|book_ie.bxon|456: You read one of Nelsen's secret books. You grasped the secret of movement in Nelsen's martial arts!
id./param/region/r011.pack|book_ie.bxon|46e: It's a book called "A Certain Treasure Hunter's Message, Chapter 3."
id./param/region/r011.pack|book_ie.bxon|475: I'm a nameless treasure hunter. Hearing a rumor that 99 mini medals earn a rainbow branch, I came to this academy.
id./param/region/r011.pack|book_ie.bxon|482: But no deal is that good. For 99 mini medals I got a somber purple Dundrasil soldier's outfit.
id./param/region/r011.pack|book_ie.bxon|490: They say it's sturdy clothing, perfect for adventurers, but it's a bit tight at my waist. Disappointing. I can't accept it.
id./param/region/r011.pack|book_ie.bxon|49b: But a cute schoolgirl told me about a country called Sniflheim, where wise people from all over the world gather.
id./param/region/r011.pack|book_ie.bxon|4a9: Going there may reveal the rainbow branch's location. My heart dances. Night is coming; where shall I sleep tonight?
id./param/region/r011.pack|book_ie.bxon|4d4: "Boss... sorry, but without the Mermaid harp, I can't set sail from here.
id./param/region/r011.pack|book_ie.bxon|4df: "The lost Mermaid harp... I hope it turns up soon.
id./param/region/r011.pack|book_ie.bxon|4ed: "Where do you think you're going, {var:1}? First we escape from here and return to Phnom Nonh.
id./param/region/r011.pack|book_ie.bxon|4f7: "A big rift has formed where Meltoa was just now. We can return to the original world from there.
id./param/region/r011.pack|book_ie.bxon|509: The people of the parade went back to the village.
id./param/region/r011.pack|book_ie.bxon|513: North: Medal Academy. South: Phnom Nonh.

tm.プワチャット遺跡の神秘！\n壁画にて微笑む 妖艶なる美女が\n絵を見た者に 幸福: Mysteries of the Pwachat Ruins! The enchanting beauty smiling in the mural brings happiness to all who see her!
tm.世紀の怪談 呪いの壁画の舞台となった\nプチャラオ村へ ようこそ。\nハラハラド: Welcome to Phnom Nonh, setting of the century's ghost story, the Cursed Mural. Savor the mystery and thrills!
tm.「なあ {var:1}。\n このコが はたらいてる宿屋は\n 村いちばんの宿屋: "Hey, {var:1}. The inn where this girl works is said to be the best in the village.
tm.「村人から話を聞いても メルっていう\n 迷子の手がかりは つかめそうにないし\: "Asking the villagers gives no clue about the lost child named Mel. How about we stay at the inn for now?
tm.「もしかして この女の子が\n 例の迷子かと思って 話してたんだけど\n どうや: "I was talking to this girl thinking she might be the lost child, but I guess I was mistaken.
tm.「セーニャや 他のみんなは 階段を下りて\n 村の入り口の広場に 向かったみたい: "Serena and the others went down the stairs toward the plaza at the village entrance. Look there too.
tm.「{var:1}さま ごめんなさい。\n まだ メルちゃんも 彼女のご両親も\n: "I'm sorry, {var:1}. We still haven't found Mel or her parents...
tm.「この子たちなら 同じ子供同士ですし\n 何か 知っているかもと 思ったのですが: "I thought these children might know something, being her age, but they say they've never heard of her.
tm.「ここなら 村を一望できると 思ったけど\n メルちゃんの パパとママらしき人は: "I thought we could see the whole village from here, but I don't see anyone who looks like Mel's mom and dad...
tm.「{var:1}ちゃんは 遺跡の方を探してみて。\n 遺跡は さっきアタシとメル: "{var:1}, look toward the ruins. They're down the stairs past the hill where Mel and I were.
tm.「アタシも もうすこし この辺りを見たら\n すぐに 後を追いかけるわ。\n よ: "I'll look around here a bit more and follow right after. Count on me, {var:1}.
tm.「変ね メルちゃんの姿が 見当たらないわ。\n あの子まで どこかに行っちゃうな: "Strange, I can't find Mel. Now she's gone somewhere too... Is something going on in this village...
tm.「{var:1}ちゃん あの子を探しましょう。\n 人通りの多い 広場の方に行け: "{var:1}, let's look for her. If we go to the busy plaza, someone may have seen her.
tm.「そういえば さっきの呼び込みの男\n 宿屋に泊まれば 何かわかるって\n 言っ: "Come to think of it, that barker said we'd learn something if we stayed at the inn...
tm.「……ふう この村の構造は\n 足腰に こたえるわい。: "...Whew, this village's layout is hard on my legs.
tm.「カミュたちは すでに遺跡へ向かったようじゃ。\n わしは しばし休憩してから: "Erik and the others seem to have already headed for the ruins. I'll rest a while and follow, so go ahead without me.
tm.「この辺りに 迷子の少女がいなかったか\n ここの露天商に 聞いてみたのじゃが\: "I asked the vendor here if a lost girl had been around, but sadly he hasn't seen her.
tm.「いったい どこに行ってしまったのか……。\n どうにも 心配じゃのう。: "Where on earth could she have gone...? I'm so worried.
tm.「例の遺跡は 階段を上った先にある\n 高台を下りた 場所にあるわ。\n みんな: "The ruins are past the stairs, down from the hill. Everyone should have gone ahead.
tm.「……それにしても この村の雰囲気は 独特ね。\n 遺跡の観光で 有名な場所とは: "...Still, this village has a unique atmosphere. It's famous for its ruins, but the fervor here is almost scary.
tm.「キミの言っていた そのメルちゃんって子\n お父さまや お母さまと はぐれて\: "That girl Mel you mentioned, separated from her father and mother... she must feel so helpless.
tm.「私も １６年前の あの夜は……。: "That night sixteen years ago, I too...
tm.「……ううん なんでもない。\n 彼女が さびしい思いをしないよう\n 私たちで: "...No, it's nothing. Let's find her quickly so she doesn't feel lonely.
tm.くちた石碑に 文字が刻まれている。\nどうやら この壁画を発見した者が\n書きの: Words are carved on the crumbling stone tablet. It seems to be a message left by whoever discovered this mural...
tm.私が 偶然にも 村のそばで発見した\n数百年前に滅亡した 古代プワチャット王国の: Near the village, I chanced upon a mysterious mural of the ancient Pwachat Kingdom, fallen centuries ago...
tm.これで 人も集まり 村も栄えるはずだった。\n……しかし それは 大きな過ちだっ: People would gather and the village would prosper. ...But that was a grave mistake. The mural was cursed with evil.
tm.壁画は 人間の命を自らの糧とするため\n人々の欲望を不思議なチカラでかなえ 惑わ: To feed on lives, the mural grants desires with strange power, misleads people, and absorbs those seeking its blessings.
tm.また 欲深くない者の前には 少女の姿で現れ\n人の善意につけ入って あざむき\n: And before the unselfish, it appears as a girl, preys on their goodwill, deceives them, and drags them into the mural...
tm.……石碑に刻まれた文字は\nここで途切れて 終わっている。: ...The writing on the tablet breaks off here.
tm.この空間の亀裂から 外の世界に戻れそうだ。\n裂け目に 飛び込みますか？: A crack in this space might lead back to the outside world. Jump into the rift?
tm.壁画の中の世界に 向かいますか？: Go to the world inside the mural?
tm.先ほどまでいた場所では\nいばらの触手が 不気味に うごめいている。\n今は 戻: Where you just were, thorny tentacles writhe eerily. It's best not to go back now.
tm.今は バハトラのために\nプチャラオ村に向かったほうが よさそうだ。: For now, it seems best to head to Phnom Nonh for Bahatra.
tm.「{var:1} 待て。\n シルビアは 村から出ていないはずだ。\n ヤツを: "Wait, {var:1}. Sylvando shouldn't have left the village. Don't you need to find him?
tm.『偉大なるガンバルディと その設計』\nという本だ。: It's a book called "The Great Gambaldi and His Designs."
tm.偉大なる設計士 ガンバルディが残した\nあまたの作品の中で 最高傑作と うたわれ: Of the many works left by the great designer Gambaldi, the masterpiece is said to be a ship called the Sylvando.
tm.シルビア号は 速さ 美しさ どれをとっても\n世界最高の船だが 高性能の秘密は\: The Sylvando is the world's finest ship in speed and beauty; experts say its secret is the distinctive bow.
tm.通常の船は 波を切るように進むというが\nシルビア号は 針のように するどい船首: Ships cut through waves, but the Sylvando's needle bow glides as if playing with them, never resisting or wounding.
tm.その姿は さながら 陽気な旅芸人のようで\nこの船の設計を依頼した 彼の友人を思: Its appearance is like a cheerful traveling entertainer, reminiscent of the friend who commissioned its design.
tm.『古代プワチャット王国の秘密』という本だ。: It's a book called "Secrets of the Ancient Pwachat Kingdom."
tm.古代プワチャット王国が滅びた 本当の原因は\n現代にいたるまで 解明されていない: The true cause of the ancient Pwachat Kingdom's fall remains unsolved, but recent research has revealed some things.
tm.滅びゆく国にも 暮らしている人はいる。\n病や天災が理由ならば 残された人々は\: Even a dying nation has people living in it. If caused by plague or disaster, the survivors would hold rites for the dead.
tm.しかし プワチャット遺跡には\n人間の墓や 埋葬した痕跡が見られない。: But the Pwachat Ruins show no human graves or traces of burial.
tm.つまり プワチャット王国の 最後には\nとむらう者すら 残っていなかった。\nそ: This implies that at the kingdom's end, not even mourners remained. A terrifying hypothesis arises.
tm.同じ特徴が 見られるのは\nバンデルフォン王国 ユグノア王国\nふたつの 滅びた: The same features appear in the ruins of two fallen great kingdoms: Bandelfon and Dundrasil.
tm.ここから 考えられることの ひとつとして\n命を根絶やしにすることを 目的とした: One possibility is that they were attacked by monsters bent on wiping out all life.
tm.『おほしさまになったら』という絵本だ。\nベッドに横になった女性が 少年のアタマ: It's a picture book called "When I Become a Star." An illustration shows a woman lying in bed gently stroking a boy's head.
tm.ああ かわいい シュベル。\nそんなに 泣かないでちょうだい。\nママは きえて: Oh, my sweet Schwell. Please don't cry so. Mama isn't going to disappear.
tm.大樹さまに おねがいをして\n空で いっとう たかいところにある\nおほしさまに: I'll ask the Great Tree to make me the highest star in the sky.
tm.そうして あなたが つらいときも\nよろこびにふるえる そのときも\nお空で ず: Then, whether you are sad or trembling with joy, I'll be watching you from the sky forever.
tm.だから シュベル 泣かないでいて。\nそのかわいい りょうのめで\nお空にひかる: So Schwell, don't cry. With your sweet eyes, find Mama's star shining in the sky.
tm.『プチャラオ村の歩き方』という\n観光案内用の無料冊子だ。: It's a free tourist pamphlet called "A Walker's Guide to Phnom Nonh."
tm.近年 遺跡の奥に 壁画の美女が発見され\n幸運を呼ぶ パワースポットとして\n人: Recently a beauty was found in a mural deep in the ruins, making the Pwachat Ruins popular as a lucky power spot.
tm.この遺跡は 数百年前に滅亡した\n古代プワチャット王国の遺構と 考えられている。: These ruins are thought to be remains of the ancient Pwachat Kingdom, destroyed hundreds of years ago.
tm.広大な領地と 富を誇ったプワチャット王国が\nなぜ滅びの道を 歩むことになったの: Why did the Pwachat Kingdom, proud of its vast lands and wealth, walk the road to ruin?
tm.王の乱心による政治の崩壊。天災による崩壊。\nまたは 魔物の急襲など さまざまな: Theories include the king's madness, disaster, or a sudden monster attack, but the mystery remains unsolved.
tm.プワチャット遺跡を 訪れる際には\n幸運を祈るだけでなく 失われし王国の足跡に\: When visiting the Pwachat Ruins, why not only pray for luck but also reflect on the lost kingdom's footsteps?
tm.どうやら かなり古い本のようだ……。\nかすれた装丁には 古い文字で\n『ネルセ: It seems to be a very old book... The faded cover reads, in old letters, "Nelsen's Secret Book: Water."
tm.我が武術における 動きの極意は\n水の一字で 表される。: The secret of movement in my martial art is expressed in one word: water.
tm.何物にとらわれない 流れる水のように動くのだ。\nそうすれば どんなに素早い 敵: Move like flowing water, bound by nothing. Then even the swiftest enemy attack can be easily dodged.
tm.ネルセンの秘伝書の ひとつを読んだ。\nネルセンの武術の 動きの極意を つかんだ: You read one of Nelsen's secret books. You grasped the secret of movement in Nelsen's martial arts!
tm.『とあるトレジャーハンターの伝言 第３章』\nという本だ。: It's a book called "A Certain Treasure Hunter's Message, Chapter 3."
tm.私は ナナシのトレジャーハンター。\nちいさなメダル９９枚で 虹色の枝が もらえ: I'm a nameless treasure hunter. Hearing a rumor that 99 mini medals earn a rainbow branch, I came to this academy.
tm.しかし そんなに うまい話があるものか。\nメダル９９枚と 交換してもらえたのは: But no deal is that good. For 99 mini medals I got a somber purple Dundrasil soldier's outfit.
tm.冒険者にぴったりの じょうぶな服だというが\n私には ウエスト周りが ちょっぴり: They say it's sturdy clothing, perfect for adventurers, but it's a bit tight at my waist. Disappointing. I can't accept it.
tm.しかし 学園の かわいらしい女生徒が\nクレイモランという国を 教えてくれた。\: But a cute schoolgirl told me about a country called Sniflheim, where wise people from all over the world gather.
tm.そこに行けば 虹色の枝のありかが\nわかるかもしれない。私の心は踊っている。\n: Going there may reveal the rainbow branch's location. My heart dances. Night is coming; where shall I sleep tonight?
tm.「ダンナ…… 申し訳ありやせんが\n マーメイドハープを 持ってないと\n ここ: "Boss... sorry, but without the Mermaid harp, I can't set sail from here.
tm.「なくしちまった マーメイドハープ……。\n 早く 見つかるといいでがすなあ。: "The lost Mermaid harp... I hope it turns up soon.
tm.「{var:1}よ どこへ行くつもりじゃ？\n まずは ここから脱出し\n プチ: "Where do you think you're going, {var:1}? First we escape from here and return to Phnom Nonh.
